core.en: A stage-like place or unit where action happens.
core.cn: 像舞台一样承载动作的场所或单元。

branches.en: A staged unit of a play or film.
branches.cn: 戏剧或电影中的一段场景。

branches.en: The real place where an event happened.
branches.cn: 事件发生的真实地点。

branches.en: A view framed like a stage set.
branches.cn: 像舞台布景一样被框住的景色。

branches.en: An emotional display performed in public.
branches.cn: 在公众面前上演的情绪表演。

branches.en: A social world with its own players.
branches.cn: 有自己参与者的社交世界。

intro.en: Scene has a family of adjectives and stage-related nouns.
intro.cn: scene 有形容词和舞台相关名词构成的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin scaena, the stage, is the direct source of scene.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 scaena（舞台）是 scene 的直接来源。

items.meaning: a place or unit of action
items.example: The scene is set at night.
The scenic road follows the coast.
items.exampleCN: 这条风景优美的路沿着海岸。
这个地区风景资源丰富。
舞台设计师搭建了布景。

items.example: Much work happens behind the scenes.
The crime scene was sealed off.

definition_en: the natural features of an area, or the painted sets on a stage
core_image: 火车窗外，青山与湖泊缓缓向后移动，像一幅展开的画卷
scene: 火车穿过山谷，窗外风景不断变换。The scenery outside the train kept changing.
sceneCN: 这里 scenery 是「风景」（第 1 个义项）；句意：火车外的风景不断变化。

senses.title: Natural landscape
senses.definition: the natural features of an area, such as hills, rivers, and forests
senses.definitionCN: 某地区的自然特征，如山丘、河流和森林
senses.example: We stopped to admire the scenery.
senses.exampleCN: 我们停下来欣赏风景。
senses.why: The core sense is the visible natural appearance of a place.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是一个地方可见的自然面貌。

senses.title: Stage sets
senses.definition: the painted boards and objects that represent a place on stage
senses.definitionCN: 舞台上用来表现地点的绘景板和道具
senses.example: The scenery was lowered between the acts.
senses.exampleCN: 幕间布景被放了下来。
senses.why: The theatre uses a built version of a natural view.
senses.whyCN: 剧场使用自然景色的搭建版本。

intro.en: Scenery is scene plus -ery, from Greek skene through Latin scaena.
intro.cn: scenery 由 scene 加 -ery 构成，经拉丁语 scaena 源自希腊语 skene。

items.en: Skene meant a stage building.
items.cn: skene 意为舞台建筑。

items.en: Scaena meant the stage.
items.cn: scaena 意为舞台。

items.en: Scenery named the painted stage background.
items.cn: scenery 指舞台上的绘景背景。

items.en: Romantic travel extended scenery to natural views.
items.cn: 浪漫主义旅行把 scenery 扩展到自然景色。

items.en: Scenery is mainly uncountable for natural landscape.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scenery 指自然风景时通常不可数。

note.en: Scenery is compared with similar spellings and with words for landscape.
note.cn: 把 scenery 与形近词以及表示风景的词作比较。

entries.definition: a place or unit of action
the visible features of an area
what can be seen from a place
a painted cloth behind a stage

normalIntro.en: Scenery is the whole collection of scenes in a place.
normalIntro.cn: scenery 是一个地方所有场景的集合。

normal.en: Scene plus ery makes the mass noun scenery.
normal.cn: scene 加 ery 构成不可数名词 scenery。

normal.en: Scenery is uncountable, so we say beautiful scenery, not sceneries.
normal.cn: scenery 不可数，所以说 beautiful scenery，不说 sceneries。

normal.en: A change of scenery means a change of surroundings.
normal.cn: a change of scenery 意为换个环境。

normal.en: Stage scenery is the painted world behind the actors.
normal.cn: 舞台布景是演员身后的绘景世界。

normal.en: Mountain scenery is a common travel phrase.
normal.cn: mountain scenery 是常见的旅行说法。

abstract.en: Scenery is what the land looks like when no one is acting.
abstract.cn: 风景是大地在没有表演时的样子。

abstract.en: The same word frames both a valley and a stage.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既框住山谷也框住舞台。

abstract.en: Travel is often a search for new scenery.
abstract.cn: 旅行常常是在寻找新的风景。

examples.en: The scenery along the coast is spectacular.
examples.cn: 沿海的风景非常壮观。

examples.en: They moved to the countryside for a change of scenery.
examples.cn: 他们搬到乡下换个环境。

examples.en: The stage scenery showed a forest at night.
examples.cn: 舞台布景显示的是夜晚的森林。

dict_mnemonic.text: scenery 是 scene 加 -ery，指「场景的总和」；自然风景和舞台布景都用它，且不可数。

root: 由 scene 加 -ery 构成，scene 源自希腊语 skene（舞台建筑），核心义「一地的景色总观或舞台布景」。

sensesIntro.en: Scenery means the natural landscape of an area or the painted sets on a stage.
sensesIntro.cn: scenery 意为某地的自然风景，或舞台上的布景。

core.en: The visible appearance of a place or stage.
core.cn: 一个地方或舞台可见的面貌。

branches.en: The natural landscape people travel to see.
branches.cn: 人们旅行观赏的自然风景。

branches.en: The built background on a stage.
branches.cn: 舞台上搭建的背景。

branches.en: Both are framed views of a place.
branches.cn: 两者都是被框住的地方景象。

branches.en: Scenery can be found outdoors or built indoors.
branches.cn: 风景既可在户外发现，也可在室内搭建。

branches.en: Whether natural or painted, scenery sets the mood.
branches.cn: 无论天然还是绘制，风景都奠定氛围。

intro.en: Scenery belongs to the scene family of visual words.
intro.cn: scenery 属于 scene 的视觉词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin scaena, stage, is the source of the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 scaena（舞台）是该词族的来源。

items.exampleCN: 我们走了风景优美的路线。

items.meaning: a place or unit of action

items.example: The stage scenery was painted by hand.
items.exampleCN: 舞台布景是手工绘制的。

definition_en: a plan that lists times for events, or to arrange an event for a time
core_image: 秘书翻开日程本，把一个个会议填进格子里
scene: 秘书把会议加进了日程表。The secretary added the meeting to the schedule.
sceneCN: 这里 schedule 是「时间表」（第 1 个义项）；句意：秘书把会议加进了日程表。

senses.title: Timetable
senses.definition: a plan listing the times when events will happen
senses.definitionCN: 列出事件发生时间的计划
senses.example: My schedule is full this week.
senses.exampleCN: 我这周的日程排满了。
senses.why: The core sense is time laid out for events.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是为事件排布好的时间。

senses.title: Progress plan
senses.definition: a plan showing stages of work and when they should finish
senses.definitionCN: 显示工作阶段及其完成时间的计划
senses.example: The project is behind schedule.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目落后于计划。
senses.why: A timetable for work becomes a progress plan.
senses.whyCN: 工作的时间表变成进度计划。

senses.title: Arrange a time
senses.definition: to arrange for something to happen at a particular time
senses.definitionCN: 安排某事在特定时间发生
senses.example: They scheduled the interview for Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把面试安排在周一。
senses.why: The noun becomes the act of putting events in time.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为把事件放入时间中的动作。

senses.title: Detailed list
senses.definition: a formal list of items, prices, or conditions
senses.definitionCN: 物品、价格或条件的正式清单
senses.example: The contract includes a schedule of costs.
senses.exampleCN: 合同包含一份费用清单。
senses.why: An ordered sheet lists what belongs where.
senses.whyCN: 有序的表格列出什么归在哪里。

intro.en: Schedule comes from Late Latin schedula, a small sheet of paper.
intro.cn: schedule 源自晚期拉丁语 schedula（小纸片）。

items.en: Skhida meant a leaf of papyrus or a strip.
items.cn: skhida 意为纸莎草叶或纸条。

items.en: Scheda meant a sheet of paper.
items.cn: scheda 意为一张纸。

items.en: Schedula was a small written note.
items.cn: schedula 是一张小便条。

items.en: Cedule named a written list or label.
items.cn: cedule 指书面清单或标签。

items.en: Schedule meant a note or explanatory list.
items.cn: schedule 意为便条或说明性清单。

items.en: Schedule now means a timetable or to arrange.
items.cn: 现代英语中 schedule 指时间表或安排。

note.en: Schedule is compared with similar spellings and with words for plans.
note.cn: 把 schedule 与形近词以及表示计划的词作比较。

entries.definition: a list of times for events
a list of items for a meeting

normalIntro.en: Schedule began as a small sheet of paper holding a list.
normalIntro.cn: schedule 最初指写有清单的一小张纸。

normal.en: A schedule is a sheet that tells you when things happen.
normal.cn: 时间表是一张告诉你何时做什么的纸。

normal.en: On schedule means exactly on time.
normal.cn: on schedule 意为准时。

normal.en: Behind schedule means late, ahead of schedule means early.
normal.cn: behind schedule 是落后，ahead of schedule 是提前。

normal.en: The British say shed-yool, Americans say sked-jool.
normal.cn: 英式读 shed-yool，美式读 sked-jool。

normal.en: A busy schedule leaves little free time.
normal.cn: 繁忙的日程几乎没有空闲时间。

abstract.en: A schedule turns time into a shape we can manage.
abstract.cn: 时间表把时间变成可以管理的形状。

abstract.en: Plans fail when the schedule is only a wish.
abstract.cn: 当时间表只是愿望时，计划就会失败。

abstract.en: A small sheet of paper can rule a whole day.
abstract.cn: 一张小纸片可以支配一整天。

examples.en: The train arrived on schedule.
examples.cn: 火车准时到达。

examples.en: He scheduled a call for the afternoon.
examples.cn: 他安排下午通电话。

examples.en: The building work is ahead of schedule.
examples.cn: 建筑工程进度提前了。

dict_mnemonic.text: schedule 原指一张写有清单的小纸，后来指把时间排成清单，即日程表；动词即「安排」。

root: 源自晚期拉丁语 schedula（小纸片），经古法语 cedule 入英语，核心义「写有时间与事项的纸」。

sensesIntro.en: Schedule means a timetable, a progress plan, to arrange a time, or a detailed list.
sensesIntro.cn: schedule 意为时间表、进度表、安排时间，或明细清单。

core.en: A written sheet that orders events in time.
core.cn: 按时间排列事项的书面表格。

branches.en: The everyday timetable of events.
branches.cn: 日常事件的时间表。

branches.en: A plan for stages of work.
branches.cn: 工作阶段的计划。

branches.en: The act of setting a time.
branches.cn: 确定时间的动作。

branches.en: A formal list of items or costs.
branches.cn: 物品或费用的正式清单。

branches.en: The timetable and the act of arranging support each other.
branches.cn: 时间表与安排动作相互支撑。

intro.en: Schedule forms verbs and nouns about time management.
intro.cn: schedule 构成与时间管理有关的动词和名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin schedula, a small sheet, is the direct source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schedula（小纸片）是直接来源。

items.structure: English plural noun and third person form
items.meaningCN: 时间表（复数）；安排（第三人称）

items.exampleCN: 排日程是他的主要任务。

items.meaning: a person or program that schedules

definition_en: a plan for achieving something, or a secret and dishonest plot
core_image: 几个人在会议室角落低声交谈，桌上摊着一张利益地图
scene: 几个同事在暗地里密谋夺权。A few colleagues schemed to take over the department.
sceneCN: 这里 scheme 是「密谋；策划」（第 3 个义项）；句意：几个同事密谋接管这个部门。

senses.title: Organized plan
senses.definition: an official or organized plan for achieving something
senses.definitionCN: 为实现某事而制定的正式或有组织的计划
senses.example: The city launched a new recycling scheme.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市启动了一项新的回收计划。
senses.why: The core sense is an arranged outline of action.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是安排好的行动纲要。

senses.title: Secret plot
senses.definition: a secret plan to gain an advantage over others
senses.definitionCN: 为取得对他人优势而制定的秘密计划
senses.example: The scheme was discovered before it began.
senses.exampleCN: 这个阴谋在开始前就被发现了。
senses.why: A private plan turns dark when it harms others.
senses.whyCN: 当计划伤害他人时，私下的计划就变得阴暗。

senses.title: Plot secretly
senses.definition: to make secret plans, often to harm others
senses.definitionCN: 制定秘密计划，常指损害他人
senses.example: They schemed to win the contract.
senses.exampleCN: 他们密谋赢得合同。
senses.why: The noun becomes the act of plotting.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为密谋的动作。

senses.title: System or arrangement
senses.definition: an organized system such as a pension or benefit arrangement
senses.definitionCN: 如养老金或福利安排的有组织体系
senses.example: The pension scheme covers all staff.
senses.exampleCN: 养老金计划覆盖所有员工。
senses.why: A plan for many people becomes an institution.
senses.whyCN: 为许多人制定的计划变成一种制度。

intro.en: Scheme comes from Greek schema, a form or figure, through Latin schema.
intro.cn: scheme 经拉丁语 schema 源自希腊语 schema（形状、图形）。

items.en: Schema meant form, shape, or figure.
items.cn: schema 意为形式、形状或图形。

items.en: Schema meant a figure or a plan.
items.cn: schema 意为图形或计划。

items.en: Scheme entered English as a diagram or outline.
items.cn: scheme 以图表或纲要之义进入英语。

items.en: Scheme gained the sense of a secret plot.
items.cn: scheme 获得阴谋的含义。

items.en: Scheme covers official programmes and private plots.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scheme 兼指官方方案与私下阴谋。

note.en: Scheme is compared with similar spellings and with words for plans and plots.
note.cn: 把 scheme 与形近词以及表示计划和阴谋的词作比较。

entries.definition: a place or unit of action

normalIntro.en: Scheme began as a shape and became a plan drawn to that shape.
normalIntro.cn: scheme 最初指形状，后来指按那个形状画出的计划。

normal.en: A scheme is a plan with a clear outline.
normal.cn: 方案就是有清晰轮廓的计划。

normal.en: A pension scheme is an official plan.
normal.cn: pension scheme 是官方计划。

normal.en: A secret scheme is a plot.
normal.cn: 秘密的方案就是阴谋。

normal.en: To scheme against someone is to plot quietly.
normal.cn: scheme against someone 就是暗中算计某人。

normal.en: Schematic drawings show a plan in simple lines.
normal.cn: schematic 图用简单线条表示方案。

abstract.en: Every scheme is a shape imposed on the future.
abstract.cn: 每个方案都是强加给未来的一种形状。

abstract.en: A plan for everyone and a plot by a few share one word.
abstract.cn: 为众人的计划与少数人的阴谋共用一个词。

abstract.en: Schemes reveal what people want before they say it.
abstract.cn: 计谋在人开口之前就暴露了他们想要什么。

examples.en: The government introduced a training scheme.
examples.cn: 政府推出了一项培训方案。

examples.en: Two managers schemed to remove the director.
examples.cn: 两名经理密谋撤掉主管。

examples.en: Their scheme collapsed when the emails were leaked.
examples.cn: 邮件泄露后，他们的阴谋破产了。

dict_mnemonic.text: scheme 与 schema 同源，本义是「形状、图式」；把未来画成图就是方案，偷偷画的就是阴谋。

root: 源自希腊语 schema（形状、图式），经拉丁语 schema 入英语，核心义「为行动画出的轮廓」。

sensesIntro.en: Scheme means an official plan, a secret plot, to plot, or an organized system.
sensesIntro.cn: scheme 意为正式方案、秘密阴谋、密谋，或有组织的制度。

core.en: An outline drawn for future action.
core.cn: 为未来行动画出的轮廓。

branches.en: A public plan for achieving something.
branches.cn: 为实现某事而制定的公开计划。

branches.en: A hidden plan that harms others.
branches.cn: 损害他人的秘密计划。

branches.en: The act of making secret plans.
branches.cn: 制定秘密计划的动作。

branches.en: A plan that becomes a system for many people.
branches.cn: 成为许多人制度的计划。

branches.en: Public and secret plans share the same outline.
branches.cn: 公开计划与秘密计划共享同一轮廓。

intro.en: Scheme has a family of planners, plotters, and diagrams.
intro.cn: scheme 有规划者、阴谋者与图表构成的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin schema, a form, is the direct source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schema（形状）是直接来源。

items.structure: English plural noun and third person form
items.meaningCN: 方案（复数）；密谋（第三人称）

items.exampleCN: 这个阴谋家终于被揭穿了。
各部件以示意图形式显示。
这个养老金计划很优厚。

definition_en: a person who studies a subject deeply, especially at a university
core_image: 一位学者伏在堆满古籍的书桌前，专注地做着批注
scene: 这位学者用十年时间研究古文字。The scholar spent ten years studying ancient scripts.
sceneCN: 这里 scholar 是「学者」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这位学者花了十年研究古文字。

senses.title: Deep researcher
senses.definition: a person who studies a subject deeply, especially at a university
senses.definitionCN: 深入研究某一学科的人，尤指在大学中
senses.example: Scholars still debate the meaning of the text.
senses.exampleCN: 学者们仍在争论这段文字的含义。
senses.why: The core sense is a person devoted to deep study.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是致力于深入研究的人。

senses.title: Prize student
senses.definition: a student who receives money to support study
senses.definitionCN: 获得资助以支持学业的学生
senses.example: She is a scholar at the local college.
senses.exampleCN: 她是当地学院的奖学金学生。
senses.why: Support for study names the student who receives it.
senses.whyCN: 对学业的资助以其获得者的名称来表达。

senses.title: Learned person
senses.definition: a person with great knowledge gained from reading and study
senses.definitionCN: 通过阅读和研究获得渊博知识的人
senses.example: The old scholar knew several ancient languages.
senses.exampleCN: 这位老学者懂好几门古代语言。
senses.why: Deep study becomes a general mark of learning.
senses.whyCN: 深入研究成为博学的普遍标志。

intro.en: Scholar comes from Latin schola, school, through Late Latin scholaris.
intro.cn: scholar 经晚期拉丁语 scholaris 源自拉丁语 schola（学校）。

items.en: Skholē meant leisure used for learning.
items.cn: skholē 意为用于学习的闲暇。

items.en: Schola meant a school or a learned discussion.
items.cn: schola 意为学校或学术讨论。

items.en: Scholaris meant of a school or a student.
items.cn: scholaris 意为学校的或学生的。

items.en: Escoler named a pupil or a learned man.
items.cn: escoler 指学生或有学问的人。

items.en: Scoler meant a student and later a learned person.
items.cn: scoler 指学生，后指博学之人。

items.en: Scholar means a specialist researcher or prize student.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scholar 指专业研究者或奖学金学生。

note.en: Scholar is compared with similar spellings and with words for learned people.
note.cn: 把 scholar 与形近词以及表示有学问之人的词作比较。

entries.definition: a person who studies a subject
a person who thinks deeply about ideas

normalIntro.en: Scholar and school share the same Latin root.
normalIntro.cn: scholar 与 school 共享同一个拉丁词根。

normal.en: Scholar begins like school, because a scholar studies there.
normal.cn: scholar 开头像 school，因为学者在学校研究。

normal.en: A scholar of history studies the past deeply.
normal.cn: a scholar of history 指深入研究历史的学者。

normal.en: A visiting scholar comes to teach and learn for a time.
normal.cn: 访问学者短期来讲学和研究。

normal.en: Scholarship is the money or the learning a scholar gains.
normal.cn: scholarship 既是奖学金也是学者的学问。

normal.en: Scholarly writing is careful and full of sources.
normal.cn: 学术写作严谨且引用丰富。

abstract.en: A scholar turns curiosity into patient work.
abstract.cn: 学者把好奇心变成耐心的研究工作。

abstract.en: The word once meant leisure, because learning needs time.
abstract.cn: 这个词原意指闲暇，因为学习需要时间。

abstract.en: A scholar keeps asking even after an answer is found.
abstract.cn: 即使找到答案，学者仍继续追问。

examples.en: Scholars from many countries attended the conference.
examples.cn: 来自许多国家的学者参加了会议。

examples.en: She became a scholar of ancient languages.
examples.cn: 她成为研究古代语言的学者。

examples.en: The young scholar won a prize for her thesis.
examples.cn: 这位年轻学者因论文获奖。

dict_mnemonic.text: scholar 与 school 同源，学校是学习之地，学者就是长期钻研学问的人。

root: 源自拉丁语 schola（学校、学习），经晚期拉丁语 scholaris 入英语，核心义「长期从事学习与研究的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Scholar means a deep researcher, a student with a scholarship, or a learned person.
sensesIntro.cn: scholar 意为深入研究的学者、获得奖学金的学生，或博学之人。

core.en: A person who gives time to deep study.
core.cn: 把时间投入深入研究的人。

branches.en: The core figure of a specialist researcher.
branches.cn: 专业研究者的核心形象。

branches.en: A student supported by an award.
branches.cn: 获得资助的学生。

branches.en: A person marked by broad learning.
branches.cn: 以广博学识著称的人。

branches.en: Deep research produces a learned reputation.
branches.cn: 深入研究造就博学的声望。

branches.en: Both study seriously, one as a career and one as a student.
branches.cn: 两者都认真治学，一个为职业，一个为学生。

intro.en: Scholar has a family linking learning, schools, and awards.
intro.cn: scholar 有连接学问、学校与奖学金的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin schola, school, is the root of the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schola（学校）是该词族的词根。

items.example: The scholar wrote a long book.
items.exampleCN: 这位学者写了一本厚书。
他没受过多少学校教育。

definition_en: money given to support study, or serious academic learning
core_image: 一封录取信旁放着奖学金证书，桌上摊着厚厚的研究笔记
scene: 她凭优异成绩拿到了全额奖学金。She won a full scholarship to study abroad.
sceneCN: 这里 scholarship 是「奖学金」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她获得了出国留学的全额奖学金。

senses.title: Study award
senses.definition: money given to a student to help pay for study
senses.definitionCN: 发给学生以资助学业的钱
senses.example: She applied for a scholarship to study abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 她申请了出国留学奖学金。
senses.why: The core sense is financial support for study.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是对学业的资助。

senses.title: Academic research
senses.definition: serious study and research in a subject
senses.definitionCN: 对某一学科进行的认真学习和研究
senses.example: His scholarship on ancient trade is well known.
senses.exampleCN: 他对古代贸易的研究广为人知。
senses.why: The award and the work share the same name.
senses.whyCN: 奖学金与学术工作共用同一个名称。

senses.title: Depth of learning
senses.definition: the level of knowledge and careful method a person shows
senses.definitionCN: 一个人所展现的知识水平与严谨方法
senses.example: The review praised the book's scholarship.
senses.exampleCN: 评论赞扬了这本书的学术水平。
senses.why: Research activity becomes a quality of the researcher.
senses.whyCN: 研究活动变成研究者的品质。

intro.en: Scholarship is scholar plus -ship, from Latin schola, school.
intro.cn: scholarship 由 scholar 加 -ship 构成，根源是拉丁语 schola（学校）。

items.en: Schola meant a school or learned discussion.
items.cn: schola 意为学校或学术讨论。

items.en: Scholaris meant of a school.
items.cn: scholaris 意为学校的。

items.en: Scoler meant a student or learned man.
items.cn: scoler 指学生或有学问的人。

items.en: Scholarship named the state or work of a scholar.
items.cn: scholarship 指学者的身份或工作。

items.en: Scholarship also names money awarded for study.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scholarship 也指用于资助学业的钱。

note.en: Scholarship is compared with similar forms and with words for study awards and learning.
note.cn: 把 scholarship 与形近形式以及表示奖学金和学问的词作比较。

entries.definition: a grant given to a student

normalIntro.en: Scholarship is what a scholar gets and what a scholar does.
normalIntro.cn: scholarship 既是学者得到的东西，也是学者做的事。

normal.en: Scholar plus ship: the ship carries money and learning.
normal.cn: scholar 加 ship：这艘船载着金钱与学问。

normal.en: A full scholarship pays all the study costs.
normal.cn: 全额奖学金支付全部学习费用。

normal.en: Academic scholarship means serious research work.
normal.cn: academic scholarship 意为严肃的学术研究。

normal.en: Win a scholarship and apply for a scholarship are common phrases.
normal.cn: win a scholarship 和 apply for a scholarship 都是常见搭配。

normal.en: The plural scholarships usually refers to awards.
normal.cn: 复数 scholarships 通常指多笔奖学金。

abstract.en: A scholarship buys time for thought.
abstract.cn: 奖学金为思考买来时间。

abstract.en: Money and learning share one word because each supports the other.
abstract.cn: 金钱与学问共用一个词，因为彼此支撑。

abstract.en: True scholarship outlives the award that funded it.
abstract.cn: 真正的学问比资助它的奖项更长久。

examples.en: The university offers scholarships to top students.
examples.cn: 这所大学为优秀学生提供奖学金。

examples.en: Her scholarship focuses on early medicine.
examples.cn: 她的学术研究聚焦早期医学。

examples.en: The book is admired for its careful scholarship.
examples.cn: 这本书因严谨的学术水平而受赞赏。

dict_mnemonic.text: scholar 加 -ship 构成 scholarship：既有「学者身份与学问」，也有资助学业的「奖学金」。

root: 由 scholar 加 -ship 构成，根源为拉丁语 schola（学校），核心义「与学者身份相关的资助与学问」。

sensesIntro.en: Scholarship means money for study, serious academic research, or depth of learning.
sensesIntro.cn: scholarship 意为奖学金、严肃的学术研究，或学识水平。

core.en: Support and work connected with being a scholar.
core.cn: 与学者身份相关的资助与工作。

branches.en: Money that supports a student's study.
branches.cn: 资助学生学业的钱。

branches.en: The serious research a scholar carries out.
branches.cn: 学者进行的严肃研究。

branches.en: The knowledge and method shown in the work.
branches.cn: 研究工作中展现的知识与方法。

branches.en: An award and research both belong to academic life.
branches.cn: 奖学金与研究都属于学术生活。

branches.en: Research work reveals the depth of learning.
branches.cn: 研究工作体现学识的深度。

intro.en: Scholarship ends the scholar family with -ship.
intro.cn: scholarship 以 -ship 收束 scholar 词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin schola, school, is the shared root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schola（学校）是共同词根。

items.meaning: a study award or academic work
items.exampleCN: 这笔奖学金改变了她的人生。

items.example: She wrote in a scholarly style.

items.exampleCN: 学业成功对他们很重要。
学校教育塑造了她的职业。
